title: Predicting radiation pneumonitis in lung cancer: a EUD-based machine learning approach for volumetric modulated arc therapy patients
summary: Original full text, Methods/Results: ML models used equivalent uniform dose features for grade≥2 radiation pneumonitis after VMAT in 77 lung-cancer patients; decision-tree AUC .98 with 70/30 split and five-fold CV. Small single-center internal evaluation. Methods/Results specify cohort, reference/outcome, split or experimental comparator and limitations.
